name: assetkit
description: Shared static assets (plants, trees, rocks, statues, textures) for many projects: the generators that make them and their assetmgr indexes.

scripts.plants:textures: python3 tools/plantgen/fetch.py && python3 tools/plantgen/paint.py && python3 tools/plantgen/pages.py
scripts.assets:upload: npm run import:nature && npm run import:sources && npm run import:statues && node ${ASSETMGR_DIR:-../assetmgr}/dist/cli.js upload
